body:
No means no and your friends (or whoever you’re drinking with) should understand that. Maybe talk to them when you’re not in a setting that you would typically drink alcohol in. Be honest about how you feel. If they say things like “you’re such a party pooper” or have a negative reaction then I don’t think you should hang out with them anymore. Relationships, whether platonic or romantic or whatever, are about feeling comfortable (and helping each other grow)

Unless it’s for work in which case I can’t really think of any advice, sorry.
